worktree.setup:
set -e
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "setup: uv not found; installing uv 0.13.7 (the version CI uses) to ~/.local/bin" >&2
    curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.13.7/install.sh | env UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh || true
    export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
  elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "setup: uv not found; installing uv 0.13.7 (the version CI uses) to ~/.local/bin" >&2
    UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 wget -qO- https://astral.sh/uv/0.13.7/install.sh | env UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh || true
    export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
  fi
fi
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  echo "error: uv is required to set up this worktree and could not be installed automatically; install it from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/ and re-run worktree setup" >&2
  exit 1
}
uv sync --locked
uv run opencode-go-model-optimizer --version
uv run pytest --collect-only -qq
echo "Worktree ready: deps + dev tools installed into .venv, CLI entry point OK, tests collect cleanly."

test-live.command: OCGO_LIVE=1 uv run pytest tests/live -m live
